visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and a blue-and-white patterned sweater walks toward a crosswalk. The camera follows him at a medium-full shot height. In the background, a large modern stadium-like building and green trees are visible under a cloudy sky. (2) A close-up shot of a green pedestrian traffic light shows the 'walking man' figure flashing as the timer counts down. Leaves of a tree are visible in the blurred background. (3) The man runs across the first half of the crosswalk and then suddenly slows down to a very slow walk halfway through. The camera pans to follow his movement across the empty urban street. (4) Close-up hands tear open a seasoning packet and squeeze a dark brown paste into a white cup of instant noodles. The noodles are dry and circular in shape. (5) In an indoor living room with a brown leather sofa, the man is about to eat. A hand wearing a black glove suddenly intervenes with chopsticks. (6) A second man appears, dressed in a black bodysuit with a black hat, long white wig, and pointed cardboard ears. He aggressively eats the noodles from the cup. (7) A brief scene in a hallway shows the elf character being chased or carried away by a person in a large green and orange bird-like mascot costume. (8) Back in the living room, the man with glasses pours white liquid from a small green bottle (coconut milk) into the cup of noodles. The elf watches intently. (9) The elf takes another bite and reacts with extreme facial expressions, squinting his eyes in delight. (10) The elf holds up a large circular cardboard badge with the character '特' drawn on it. (11) The man with glasses places the badge on his sweater sleeve. He points at it, looking confused. (12) The video ends with a still shot of the noodle cup and promotional images of fried noodle bread and sweet potatoes on a table surface.
